reviews.author: nada osman
reviews.text:
The academy is good overall, but their cancellation and refund policy is honestly very disappointing. Once you pay for a membership, whether it is for one month or three months, there is no refund if you need to cancel even if you have barely used the membership.
I understand having terms and conditions but a complete no refund policy with no flexibility at all is unreasonable.
There should at least be an option for a partial refund based on the unused period especially if you pay for long term.
So before paying for a long term membership, please read the cancellation policy carefully once you pay, your money is basically bye-bye! 👋😅
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear Nada,

Thank you for your feedback. We would like to clarify that our cancellation and refund policy is clearly communicated before payment, and the terms are also stated on the payment receipt, which was signed and accepted at the time of registration.

The signed terms clearly confirm that membership payments are non-refundable. This policy is applied consistently to all members and is not specific to your membership.

We understand that circumstances can change, and we always try to assist our members within the terms that were agreed upon. However, once a membership payment has been made and the non-refundable terms have been acknowledged and signed, we are unable to issue a refund.

We value every member of Warriors Zone Academy and appreciate your feedback. We wish you all the best

reviews.author: A. Tulaimat
reviews.text:
Warrior Zone Kickboxing Academy in Sharjah is truly one of the best martial arts academies in the UAE. The gym offers a top-notch training environment, whether you're looking to improve your fitness, learn self-defense, or train at a competitive level.

Coach Ahmad stands out as an exceptional trainer, with deep expertise in kickboxing, sports training, and nutrition. His coaching approach is both professional and personalized, ensuring that every student – from beginners to advanced fighters – gets the best training possible.

One of the things that makes Warrior Zone special is the care and attention given to kids. Coach Ahmad is great at building confidence, discipline, and strength in young learners, making it an ideal place for parents looking to enroll their children in a positive and motivating environment.

The academy is well-equipped, the atmosphere is welcoming, and the training is highly effective. If you're serious about kickboxing or just want to get in shape with the guidance of an experienced and supportive coach, Warrior Zone is the perfect place to train!
